basic.name: Windrider Bullet
basic.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Bronya's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Combat Redeployment
skill.description_template: Dispels a debuff from a single ally, allows them to immediately take action, and increases their DMG by {{scaling1}}% for 1 turn(s). When this Skill is used on Bronya herself, she cannot immediately take action again.

ultimate.name: The Belobog March
ultimate.description_template: Increases the ATK of all allies by {{scalin1}}%, and increases their CRIT DMG equal to {{scalin2g}}% of Bronya's CRIT DMG plus {{scaling3}}% for 2 turn(s).

technique.name: Banner of Command
technique.description: After using Bronya's Technique, at the start of the next battle, all allies' ATK increases by 15% for 2 turn(s).

talent.name: Leading the Way
talent.description_template: After using her Basic ATK, Bronya's next action will be Advanced Forward by {{scaling1}}%.

2.name: Command
2.description: The CRIT Rate for Basic ATK increases to 100%.

4.name: Battlefield
4.description: At the start of the battle, all allies' DEF increases by 20% for 2 turn(s).

6.name: Military Might
6.description: When Bronya is on the field, all allies deal 10% more DMG.

eidolons.name: Hone Your Strength
eidolons.description: When using Skill, there is a 50% fixed chance of recovering 1 Skill Point. This effect has a 1-turn cooldown.

eidolons.name: Quick March
eidolons.description: When using Skill, the target ally's SPD increases by 30% after taking action, lasting for 1 turn.

eidolons.name: Bombardment
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Take by Surprise
eidolons.description: After any other ally character uses Basic ATK on an enemy target that has Wind Weakness, Bronya immediately launches 1 instance of Follow-up ATK, dealing Wind DMG to this target equal to 80% of her Basic ATK DMG. This effect can only trigger once per turn.

eidolons.name: Unstoppable
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Piercing Rainbow
eidolons.description: The duration of the DMG Boost effect placed by the Skill on the target ally increases by 1 turn(s).
